risks.why: All 41 Method Atlas builder/gate functions are pure (no DB writes, no network calls, no secrets). Method execution cannot itself cause a production incident -- confirmed by this session's own critic passes across F15/F22/F23/F24 (0 side-effect findings across ~4200 tests).

Once Phase 1 exposes POST /methods/{id}/invoke publicly, unbounded free calls are a compute-abuse/DoS surface even though individual calls are cheap and side-effect-free. Requires real Identity + entitlement-check seam (decision-register.json entry 2), not just network-level rate limiting.
risks.mitigated_by: Phase 1 Identity/Tenant gate; deferred rate-limit hardening tracked for Phase 1 build task list.

risks.why: No payment processing exists in Phase 1. Billing/entitlement standards (commercial/BILLING_ARCHITECTURE.md) apply starting Phase 2 (subscription+credits) -- deferred, not skipped.

Phase 1 has exactly one real Tenant row (self-use). ADR-003 CAS isolation guarantees are declared in the schema but not yet load-bearing until a 2nd tenant exists (Phase 2). Must be verified with a real 2-tenant isolation test before Phase 2 ships, not assumed from schema shape alone.
